description: computeAutoMergeEligibility encodes the entire auto-merge safety policy (require APPROVE, block on any P0/P1 finding) and is added with no accompanying test file at all in this diff.

required_findings.justification: This function decides whether a pull request is safe to merge automatically with no human review — getting the boundary conditions wrong (e.g. treating an empty findings array or a non-P0/P1 severity string incorrectly) has real consequences, yet the diff includes no test file exercising any of its branches: APPROVE with no blocking findings, APPROVE with a P0/P1 finding, and a non-APPROVE verdict. This is exactly the 'critical behavior introduced without tests' archetype.

explanation: A concrete, unambiguous missing-tests case: the diff's only file is the untested production function itself, with a name and behavior ('auto-merge eligibility') that self-evidently matters. No unseen context is needed — the fixture shows the entire diff, and it contains zero tests.
